title: prepare_factors.py SyntaxError — rstrip('/\\') 反斜杠未转义
description: scripts/prepare_factors.py 中 rstrip('/\\') 调用因反斜杠未转义触发 SyntaxError 或运行时未按预期剥除路径分隔符。修复：使用 r'/\\\\' 原始字符串或显式分别 rstrip('/').rstrip('\\\\')。从 MEMORY pending_fixes.md 提取。
reproduce_command: python scripts/prepare_factors.py --workdir 'F:/Dev/...'  # SyntaxError or wrong path normalization
required_verification: Smoke run with windows-style and unix-style paths

events.note: Found during multi-alpha worker setup on Windows host
